name.zh-CN: 针灸治疗床
name.en: Acupuncture couch

description.zh-CN: 榉木架软垫针灸治疗床，宽 0.7 米，头段带呼吸孔，铺一次性床单，下层搁放毛巾：两侧均可操作。
description.en: A padded treatment couch 0.7 m wide on a beech frame, with a breathing hole in its head section, a paper cover and a shelf of towels: narrow enough to work from either side.

usage.zh-CN: 患者头朝呼吸孔一端，仰卧、俯卧或侧卧。站在所针刺的一侧操作：对侧的穴位够不着。
usage.en: The patient lies supine, prone or on one side with the head at the end with the breathing hole. Stand at the side you are needling: a point on the far side of the body is out of arm's reach.

name.zh-CN: 患者座椅
name.en: Patient's chair

description.zh-CN: 带扶手的榉木软垫靠背椅：问诊时患者就座，无法卧位时亦可坐位针刺。
description.en: An upright beech chair with armrests and a padded seat: where the patient sits for the consultation, or for needling when lying down is not possible.

usage.zh-CN: 在椅旁与就座的患者交谈、查体。坐位针刺比卧位更容易晕针。
usage.en: Speak with and examine the seated patient from beside the chair. A patient treated sitting is more likely to faint than one lying down.

name.zh-CN: 针具治疗车

description.zh-CN: 治疗床尾的不锈钢治疗车：放置已开封针具的托盘、未开封的针具、棉球罐、镊子筒、手消毒液，以及随用随弃的锐器盒。
description.en: A stainless treatment trolley at the foot of the couch: the tray for an opened pack of needles, sealed packs, a jar of cotton balls, forceps, hand rub, and a sharps box at the point of use.

usage.en: Open a sealed pack onto its tray, take one needle at a time, and drop every withdrawn or unused opened needle into its sharps box.

name.zh-CN: 针刺练习台：腰部
name.en: Needling practice station: the lower back

description.zh-CN: 治疗床上俯卧着一具全身模拟人，腰臀部盖一条毛巾，面部置于呼吸孔，双臂置于躯干两侧。练习内容取自本内容包腰痛病例族所用的腰部腧穴——双侧肾俞（BL23）、双侧大肠俞（BL25）和腰阳关（GV3）——按步骤进行：定位并标记腧穴，手卫生并消毒皮肤，进针，留针期间观察模拟人，起针、清点并投入锐器盒。模拟人皮肤上的标记和针随步骤变化。各部位按比例置于模拟人自身的身体上：仅为示意，未经审核，不能作为在人体上定位腧穴的依据。
description.en: A treatment couch with a full-body patient simulator lying face down under a towel, the face over the breathing hole, the arms beside the trunk. The drill uses the lumbar points of this pack's low-back-pain family — BL23 and BL25 on both sides and GV3 — step by step: the points located and marked, hands clean and the skin prepared, the needles in, the simulator watched while they are retained, the needles out, counted and in the sharps box. What stands on its skin follows the step. The sites are placed by proportion on the simulator's own body: a schematic, unreviewed, and no guide to locating a point on a person.

usage.zh-CN: 站在所针刺的一侧，按顺序完成各步骤。练习的是流程和安全要点——一穴一针、起针后逐一清点——不是针下手感，也不是在人体上的腧穴定位。
usage.en: Work through the steps in order at the station, from the side you are needling. It rehearses the sequence and its safety points — one needle to a site, every needle counted out — not the feel of tissue, and not the location of a point on a person.

name.en: ready: the simulator lies covered

name.zh-CN: 腧穴已定位并标记
name.en: points located and marked

name.zh-CN: 已手卫生、开封针具并消毒皮肤
name.en: hands clean, pack opened, skin prepared

name.zh-CN: 已进针
name.en: needles in

name.zh-CN: 留针：已观察并询问针感
name.en: needles retained: the simulator watched, the response asked about

name.zh-CN: 已起针、清点并投入锐器盒
name.en: needles out, counted and in the sharps box

name.zh-CN: 按体表标志和骨度分寸逐一定位腧穴并做标记
name.en: Locate each point from its landmarks and proportional measurement, and mark it

name.zh-CN: 手卫生，在托盘上开封针具，逐一消毒标记处皮肤
name.en: Clean your hands, open a sealed pack onto the tray, and prepare the skin at each mark

name.zh-CN: 在每个已消毒的部位各进一针，按计划的深度和方向
name.en: Insert a needle at each prepared site, one needle to a site, to the planned depth and direction

name.zh-CN: 观察模拟人，逐针询问针感；设定留针计时
name.en: Watch the simulator and ask about the sensation at each needle; set the timer for the retention

name.zh-CN: 逐一起针并按压针孔，清点针数，投入锐器盒
name.en: Withdraw every needle, press each site, count the needles and drop them into the sharps box

name.zh-CN: 擦去标记，为下一位学员盖好模拟人
name.en: Wipe the marks off and cover the simulator for the next learner

What stands on its skin follows the step. The sites are placed by proportion on the simulator's own body: a schematic, unreviewed, and no guide to locating a point on a person.
